markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 强调句就是把一句话**拆成两半**，把最想强调的部分**拎出来摆在显眼处**。常用两种：**It was … that …**（「就是……」）和 **What … is …**（「……的是……」）。

uses.en_zh: 发现这个 bug 的就是 Maya。

uses.en: [[It was]] on Friday [[that]] the server went down.

itThat.title: It is / It was … that …
itThat.rule: 把要强调的放进 It was 和 that 中间。过去的事用 It was。强调人可以用 who。检查办法：**去掉 It was 和 that，句子还是完整的。**

examples.en: [[It was]] the API [[that]] caused the crash, not the app.
examples.zh: 导致崩溃的是 API，不是 App。

examples.en: [[It's]] Sam [[who]] knows the most about Core Data.
examples.zh: 最懂 Core Data 的是 Sam。

examples.en: [[It was]] in 2019 [[that]] I joined the team.
examples.zh: 我是 2019 年加入团队的。

itThat.tip: 常常后面跟一句 not …，说「是这个，不是那个」。

what.title: What … is …：先卖关子
what.rule: 先卖个关子，**把重点留到最后说**。口语里很常用，用来说想要的、需要的、喜欢的、担心的。

examples.en: [[What]] I love about Swift [[is]] how clean it looks.
examples.zh: 我喜欢 Swift 的地方是它看起来很干净。
让我担心的是截止日期。
我们需要的是更多测试。

action.title: 强调做了什么
action.rule: 想强调「**做了什么动作**」，用 What + 主语 + **do / did** + is / was，再接**动词原形**。

examples.en: [[What I did was]] ((call)) the client directly.
examples.zh: 我做的就是直接给客户打了电话。

examples.en: [[What you should do is]] ((restart)) the simulator.
examples.zh: 你该做的是重启模拟器。

examples.en: [[What happened was]] the build server ran out of space.
examples.zh: 事情是这样的：构建服务器磁盘满了。

wrong.bad: What I did was ~~called~~ the client.

items.zh: 我就想要一个安静的周末。

items.rule: **The reason … is that**，不说 is because
items.en: [[The reason]] I left [[is that]] the commute was too long.
items.zh: 我离职是因为通勤太远。

items.en: [[The thing]] I like most [[is]] the team.
items.zh: 我最喜欢的是这个团队。

items.rule: 动词前加 **do / does / did**，强调「真的」

this.meaning: 强调句：突出「是 Maya，不是别人」

that.meaning: 普通句：只是说出这件事

this.meaning: 强调句：去掉 It was … that 句子还完整

that.meaning: 定语从句：that 后面是在说明是哪个

commonMistakes.why: It … 句里用 that，不用 what。

commonMistakes.bad: What I need ~~it~~ is a break.
commonMistakes.why: what 已经代替了要的东西，不用 it。

commonMistakes.bad: What I did was ~~called~~ the client.
commonMistakes.good: What I did was [[call]] the client.

commonMistakes.bad: The reason is ~~because~~ I was ill.
commonMistakes.good: The reason is [[that]] I was ill.
commonMistakes.why: the reason is 后面接 that。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我需要的是一杯咖啡。
quiz.answer: What I need is a coffee.
accept: What I need is a cup of coffee.
All I need is a coffee.

quiz.prompt: 用 It was … who 强调 Maya：Maya found the bug.
quiz.answer: It was Maya who found the bug.
accept: It was Maya that found the bug.
quiz.explain: 把 Maya 放进 [[It was]] 和 [[who]] 中间。

quiz.prompt: 用 It was … that 强调时间：The server went down on Friday.
quiz.answer: It was on Friday that the server went down.
quiz.explain: 把 on Friday 放进 [[It was]] 和 [[that]] 中间。

quiz.prompt: ___ in 2019 that I joined the team.
用 What … is 改写：The deadline worries me.
quiz.answer: What worries me is the deadline.
accept: The deadline is what worries me.

quiz.prompt: ___ I love about Swift is how clean it looks.
改错：What I need it is a break.
quiz.answer: What I need is a break.
quiz.explain: what 已经代替了要的东西，去掉 it。

quiz.prompt: What I did was ___ the client directly.
用 What you should do is 改写：You should restart the simulator.
quiz.answer: What you should do is restart the simulator.
accept: What you should do is to restart the simulator.
quiz.explain: [[What you should do is]] + 动词原形。

quiz.prompt: ___ I want is a quiet weekend.（我就想要……）
改错：The reason I left is because the commute was too long.
quiz.answer: The reason I left is that the commute was too long.
accept: I left because the commute was too long.
The reason I left was that the commute was too long.

quiz.prompt: 强调「我真的发了」：I ___ send the email!
改错：It's the deadline what worries me.
quiz.answer: It's the deadline that worries me.
accept: It is the deadline that worries me.

options: It was the API that failed.
This is the API that failed.
quiz.answer: It was the API that failed.
quiz.explain: 去掉 It was … that 还剩 the API failed，是强调句。

quiz.prompt: 改错：It is in 2019 that I joined.
quiz.answer: It was in 2019 that I joined.

openTask.prompt: 用 3 句强调句说说你的工作：一句 It was … that / who，一句 What I … is，一句 All I want is 或 The reason … is that。
rules: It 句过去的事用 It was，人可以用 who
What … was 后面接动词时用原形；the reason … is that
openTask.note: 规则判强调句结构（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
